notes: Section 8 (Golden Gate Park east end, Sunset/Parnassus, Twin Peaks, Sutro Forest), 1-bit photocopy, 2550x3312, page turned ~0.35 deg (left rule x 420 at the top to 436 at the bottom; top rule y 247 to 240, bottom 3050 to 3023). Frame on all four sides: thick bar, white hairline, thin inner rule (the innermost rule), with a thick + thin quarter arc in every corner. The outline lies on paper 1-2 px inside the thin rule's inner edge (README rules 1, 8), points every <=60 px. Right side y 499-534: the thin rule is missing in the copy for 36 px; the outline keeps the fitted line. Corners (rule 2): the outline follows the inner edge of the arc band (thin arc, in places merged with the thick one) 1-2 px inside it; where an arc leaves its side rule through a short stub the outline goes round the stub (TL: stub on the left rule y 355-363 and band end on the top rule at x 537; TR x 2234 / y 351; BL: stub on the left rule from y 2938 and band end on the bottom rule at x 550; BR y 2908 / x 2247), so stubs stay outside. Kind (b), map ink that truly touches the frame and is left under the outline: the solid commercial blocks on the left at y ~840-1020 and ~2370-2400 run into the left rule (fully black stretches); the edge line of the hatched blocks on the left at y ~2140-2240 is merged with the thin rule and the outline follows the rule's inner edge through it; the hatching of the first-residential area runs into the bottom rule along x ~770-2250 (a hatch line every ~15 px) and into the right rule at y ~2260-2930; street and lot lines touch the top rule (x ~545-1900) and the right rule; hatch lines touch the BL arc (y 2937, 2956) and the BR arc (x 2255, y 2894-2897, 2919-2921). On the right at y ~1577-1597 the thin rule prints 1-2 px fatter where a street line meets it; the outline keeps the fitted edge. remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP title, LEGEND swatches and the 1000 scale bar (top right, no ruled box, on blank paper), a rectangle 4-6 px outside its ink with its top-right corner cut off inside the TR arc (bottom edge in the ~5 px of paper between the scale bar and the first block row); the rectangle also covers the SECTION badge, which sits beside the title's first lines; (2) the compass rose with its true-north arrow (tip 1702,1299), the magnetic needle (tip 1762,1316) and the tail feather (down to y 1729): it is printed over the diagonal hatching of the Sutro Forest first-residential area, so the 12-point outline takes the whole rose and crosses hatch lines all round (that is the remove-outline ink), and a dotted road line passes through its lower right; the hatching inside the polygon goes with it (README rule 4: the block is taken whole); (3) the SECTION 8 badge (ring centre 2259.6,306.6, outer radius 31.4), an octagon 5 px outside the ring, on blank paper (inside the title rectangle). 'Join Sec.' lettering prints outside the frame. Doubt: none on the frame; the compass outline is by eye where its fine rays meet the hatching.
drawn_by: Claude (training-label agent LA, issue #71), 2026-11-21: from the scan and inputs/frame-labels/README.md only (no model output looked at). Sides: inner edge of the innermost (thin) rule measured every 2nd px from luminance profiles (thin run beside the bar), robust local-linear fit, then each px of the outline re-set 2 px inside the rule's measured inner end where paper lies inside it (within 1.5 px of the fit; the fit kept where map ink is merged with the rule). Corner arcs: circle fitted to the arc band's inner edge along rays, plus the measured residual by angle; arc ends (stubs) hand-placed from pixel dumps. Remove blocks from full-resolution crops. Checked on straightened 3x/6x strips of the whole outline (every vertex), pixel dumps of all eight arc ends, and the ranked ink stretches.
